gate_changes_reviewed: No scientific admission, novelty, reduction, comparator, readiness, or hard-integrity threshold changed.
Control R16 interpreted null hold_class/hold_reason on a REJECT terminal candidate as v2.1 incompleteness and described a pending 15/16 view.

Evidence Analyst R20 explicitly rejected that interpretation: hold_class/hold_reason are applicable iff classification=HOLD; the REJECT candidate correctly keeps them null, producing canonical 16/16 completeness.

This cross-role applicability disagreement is a material funnel-observability defect because it can generate false incompleteness and unnecessary policy blocking; the applicability mask should be clarified prospectively.
Fresh delayed-action responsibility Discovery was prospectively MECHANISM, used clean exact API/source preflight and a fixed one-slot ordinary comparator, then accepted REJECT with no rescue.
Latest MAIN SYSTEM Architecture work stopped at unsupported reachability/contract ambiguity; no comparable executable MECHANISM existed, so no SYSTEM-priority exception was needed.
MAIN freshness dependency correctly failed closed when a newer SUB generation was not yet reviewed by Analyst.
false_positive_risks: A future role could mark a fully classified REJECT object incomplete by demanding HOLD-only fields, causing false funnel incompleteness and policy suppression.
A future producer could regress on terminal/API semantics after outcome exposure; current preflight and method-limit containment remain appropriate.
A future SYSTEM-over-comparable-MECHANISM allocation could be justified post hoc unless system_priority_exception is persisted prospectively; first live use remains unobserved.
Funnel conversion counts could be overinterpreted if true classification completeness falls; current canonical reviewed population is 16/16 complete and rates remain descriptive.
false_negative_risks: Do not force HOLD labels or reasons onto REJECT objects merely to satisfy a uniform schema; this obscures disposition semantics and can create unnecessary blocking.
Do not convert the current 2/3 MECHANISM rolling share into a target; useful SYSTEM work must remain admissible.
Do not require a positive signal before every bounded Discovery question; reserve signal requirements for promotion and strong claims.
READY could become a hidden second Formal gate if future practice requires prior comparator/reduction/falsifier success rather than a well-defined informative next test; no READY case exists yet.
Avoid serial near-neighbor responsibility/credit probes when they cease to add distinct mechanism information; use marginal information gain and the no-target exception when appropriate.

The completed Assembly Architecture object remained SYSTEM-only and terminal. No current-object prestige relabeling or same-object upgrade was observed.

mechanism_supply_health.finding: The one-in-three floor is satisfied without quota manufacturing. The latest mechanism question was falsifiable, prospectively reduced, and accepted a negative result. Continue selection by marginal information gain rather than by increasing the mechanism ratio.
